text:
jamal-sales: Quick heads-up  Prospect demo in 30m. Client getting 403s on /v1/generate with the trial token. Can someone triage?

lee-eng: can you paste the exact curl + response body? even a redacted key is fine.

client_dev: here
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd_trial_ABCDEF" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"hello"}'
```
Response:
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"token missing project claim for project:acme-demo","code":403}

ado-support: that message means the JWT doesn't include a project claim for acme-demo. Are you using the trial key across multiple projects?

client_dev: yes the account has multiple projects. We didn't add any X-Redwood headers in the demo script.

lee-eng: two quick fixes: 1) add bind headers: `-H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-org" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-demo"`, 2) if that still 403s I'll mint a short-lived project-scoped key you can use for the call.

client_dev: tried headers, still 403 with same message.

ado-support: on it  creating temp key with scopes ["generate:write", "embeddings:read"] TTL=90m. I'll DM the key to your contact.

quota-bot: policy-evaluator: blocked request reason=missing_project_claim expected=project:acme-demo request_id=cc3a45

client_dev: switched to temp key and calls succeed now. thanks! Two follow-ups from the demo: 1) they asked what scopes they need for embeddings + generation, 2) they hit a 429 when running 6 parallel streams during a quick load demo.

lee-eng: scopes: for demo minimal set is ["generate:write", "embeddings:read"]. 429 = rate-limit/concurrency; trial/demo keys are rate limited. For sustained or high-concurrency tests we recommend a reserved capacity pilot or a day-long elevated quota.

jamal-sales: I'll add pricing options to the deal thread: 24h elevated quota vs reserved slot for predictable throughput. Also noting they were filling a security questionnaire asking about HIPAA / BAA.

ado-support: HIPAA/BAA: we offer Private deployment and BAAs for enterprise customers; not available for trial keys. I'll loop in security to answer the questionnaire items and add the note to the sales pack.

lee-eng: one more note for their engineers: avoid rotating keys simultaneously across workers. Pre-stage new key, roll updates, validate, then revoke old key to avoid transient 403s/401s. Also ensure NTP sync to avoid nbf/iat token errors.

client_dev: got it. We
ll re-run tests on the call. Thanks for the quick help.

jamal-sales: closing loop  I'll follow up with the temp key expiry and pricing options. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
